"import openmdao.api as om
import json
import pycycle.api as pyc

prob = om.Problem()

# Independent variables (design point inputs)
prob.model.add_subsystem('des_vars', om.IndepVarComp())
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('alt', 0.0, units='ft')
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('MN', 0.000001)
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('Tt4', 2900.0, units='degR')
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('OPR', 16.0)
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('Fn_target', 14000.0, units='lbf')
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('ram_recovery', 1.0)
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('Ps_exhaust', 14.696, units='psi')
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('dPqP', 0.04)
prob.model.des_vars.add_output('Nmech', 10000.0, units='rpm')

# Cycle group (design point)
prob.model.add_subsystem('cycle', pyc.Cycle())
prob.model.cycle.options['thermo_method'] = 'TABULAR'
prob.model.cycle.options['thermo_data'] = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
prob.model.cycle.options['config_name'] = 'turbojet'

# Add components to cycle
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('fl_in', pyc.FlightConditions())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.AXI5())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.LPT2269())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('nozz', pyc.Nozzle())
prob.model.cycle.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(aero='turb', shaft='shaft'))

# Flow path (thermodynamic stations)
prob.model.cycle.connect('fl_in.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
prob.model.cycle.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
prob.model.cycle.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
prob.model.cycle.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
prob.model.cycle.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'nozz.Fl_I')

# Mechanical connections (compressor driven by turbine)
prob.model.cycle.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_0')
prob.model.cycle.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_1')

# Promote cycle inputs to cycle level
prob.model.cycle.promotes('fl_in', inputs=['alt', 'MN'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('inlet', inputs=['ram_recovery'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('comp', inputs=['Nmech', 'OPR'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('burner', inputs=['dPqP', 'Tt4'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('turb', inputs=['Nmech'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('nozz', inputs=['Ps_exhaust', 'dPqP'])
prob.model.cycle.promotes('shaft', inputs=['Nmech'])

# Connect design variables to cycle inputs
prob.model.connect('des_vars.alt', 'cycle.alt')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.MN', 'cycle.MN')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.ram_recovery', 'cycle.ram_recovery')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.OPR', 'cycle.OPR')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.Tt4', 'cycle.Tt4')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.dPqP', 'cycle.dPqP')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.Ps_exhaust', 'cycle.Ps_exhaust')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.Nmech', 'cycle.Nmech')

# Cycle solver (Newton for internal balances)
prob.model.cycle.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver()
prob.model.cycle.nonlinear_solver.options['atol'] = 1e-8
prob.model.cycle.nonlinear_solver.options['rtol'] = 1e-8
prob.model.cycle.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

# Outer balance: solve for W such that net thrust = Fn_target
prob.model.add_subsystem('w_match', om.BalanceComp())
prob.model.w_match.add_eq('W', units='lbm/s', eq_units='lbf',
                         lhs_name='Fn', rhs_name='Fn_target', val=100.0)
prob.model.connect('cycle.nozz.Fn', 'w_match.Fn')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.Fn_target', 'w_match.Fn_target')
prob.model.connect('w_match.W', 'cycle.fl_in.W')

# Top-level solver
prob.model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver()
prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options['atol'] = 1e-8
prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options['rtol'] = 1e-8
prob.model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

prob.setup()
prob.run_model()

# Extract results
Fn_lbf = float(prob.get_val('cycle.nozz.Fn')[0])
W_val = float(prob.get_val('w_match.W')[0])
FAR = float(prob.get_val('cycle.burner.Fl_O:FAR')[0])
Wfuel = W_val * FAR
TSFC = Wfuel / Fn_lbf * 3600.0  # lbm/(lbf*hr)

result = {
    'Fn_lbf': float(Fn_lbf),
    'TSFC': float(TSFC),
    'OPR': 16.0,
    'Wfuel_lbm_s'"
